prompts.prompt:
Create an original premium editorial illustration for Vocaflow, an English learning web platform. Visual language: the sophisticated architectural/technical editorial drawings of tines.com Stories/Product: precise fine consistent dark aubergine outlines, flat spot colors on distinct geometric planes, elegant shallow axonometric depth, deliberate open negative space and small functional construction details. NOT a cute app icon, NOT a generic stock education illustration, NOT a glossy 3D render, NOT watercolor, NO sparkles, NO central square tile, NO background rectangle, NO blurry gradients or shadows. Palette: crisp lavender #d3caff and #bcabff balanced with mint #aedac2 / #57be90, warm apricot #ff9f5f, pink #ff97d0, yellow #ffd077, cream, outlines #412478. Keep vivid accents deliberately distributed, not everything purple. Fine engraved guides, apertures, joints, rails, tabs and offset planes should express how the object works. Hero image must have a memorable designed silhouette readable at 420 CSS pixels, with subordinate details visible on close inspection. Landscape 3:2 canvas; all artwork contained with ~5% clear padding and ~85% occupied silhouette width. Truly transparent background, no text/logos/letters/numbers. One coherent conceptual object rather than a bag of floating unrelated stationery.
Subject: MEMORY RETRIEVAL OBSERVATORY. Design an ingenious compact architectural instrument: an open circular card-index carousel on a precise rotating spindle, a tall offset portal/aperture selecting a single cream card, a curved return rail leading into layered archive fins. Show index tabs, evenly spaced radial slots, a small suspended selector arm, solid lavender structural planes, mint return rail, peach counterweight, pink hinges. Suggest retrieving and returning a memory through this engineered loop. Asymmetric, elegant and purposeful, not a file drawer, not a book stack, not a clock, not a toaster or casino gadget. Large dominant carousel/portal with a small secondary rail, 3-4 clear masses; professional technical drawing quality.

Background extraction / precise alpha cutout ONLY. Keep the illustrated object, every line, every color, geometry and composition exactly unchanged. Remove the large diffuse purple/grey cloudy GLOW that surrounds the object, including underneath it and between disconnected parts. Do not paint a background. All empty space must be truly transparent alpha 0. All solid planes of the actual illustrated object must be fully opaque alpha 255, including cream cards/pages. Only use partial alpha on a narrow antialiased edge, never as a large halo. No shadow, no lighting effect, no tinted haze. This will sit on both cream and dark webpage backgrounds. Preserve full resolution and complete subject. Do not simplify or redesign.

Image1 is the illustration to refine; Image2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, showing the real Tines product hero. Do not reproduce its webpage, text, logo or exact composition. Match Image2's exceptionally clean flat technical/architectural drawing: thin perfectly consistent aubergine vector-like outlines, large SOLID flat color planes, clean cutaway edges and limited shallow axonometric depth. Every plane must be a single solid color. REMOVE ALL painterly gradients, textures, glows and drop shadows, including the cloudy halo around the cutout. Transparent pixels around the object must be completely clear, not tinted translucent fog. Palette should match Image2: lavender plus clearly visible apricot, pink, mint, cream; avoid everything being purple or pastel grey. Art-directed and detailed through designed structure rather than random decoration. NO letters or text. High-end professional editorial illustration, not a toy render or children's fantasy book. Landscape3:2 full object with 6% transparent margins. Keep the surprising book-as-arched-reading-gallery concept and the page bridge, but redesign the architecture as crisp contemporary geometric blocks. Remove all foliage, vintage railings, decorative gold finials, domed tower, tassels, engraving, tiny busy book spines and Victorian ornament. Use three simple rectilinear arches, a stepped book gallery with clearly spaced colored spines, a folded page bridge and one open rectangular index tower. Preserve functional page layers, tabs, ladder and inset panels. Strong 3-mass architectural silhouette with a few well-drawn construction details.
